name: Cs Handoff Document
description: Produces a sales-to-customer-success handoff document with customer context, commitments made during the sale, success criteria, and onboarding plan using CS onboarding methodology. Use when the user asks to create a customer handoff document, build a sales-to-CS transition template, write a customer onboarding brief, document commitments made during a sale, or prepare a new customer for implementation. Do NOT use for follow-up emails after a sale (use follow-up-sequences), customer support scripts (not a sales skill), or internal team onboarding (use onboarding-plan).
